summary_1line: Bhishma recounts Lakshmi’s preferred virtues and places of residence, then begins the tale of King Bhangaswana transformed into a woman by Indra.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Bhangaswana emerges from a clear forest lake and realizes with shock that he has been transformed into a woman.
The radiant goddess Lakshmi, lotus-complexioned and moon-faced, speaks before Krishna and Rukmini about where prosperity resides.
Two hundred royal princes clash in battle after being incited by Indra disguised as a Brahmana.
